crossRefs.note: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain…
The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
For the land, where you go in to possess isn’t like the land of Egypt that you came out of, where you sowed your seed…
that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your…
I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There…

translations.web: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
translations.bsb: You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.
translations.kjv: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
translations.asv: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, Thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
